annotations.text:
The field is the tab bar.

On iOS 26 the Search tab's capsule expands in place: the bar becomes a full-width field and the capsule becomes the close button. There is no header search and no Cancel. The keyboard rides above the field — undrawn here, so every artboard shows the moment it has been dismissed and the field has settled back to the bottom.

Before a query, Search shows Recent records.

Kept on this phone, for this Group only — never synchronised, and never a shared activity feed.

The query fires at two non-whitespace characters, on a 200 ms trailing debounce. Clearing and closing apply at once.

No scope pill: the spec rules out type filters, so there is nothing at the top of the list.
A query in flight never shows the previous query's results. Skeleton rows in the shape of the real ones — no spinner over content.

Nothing found offers a way back, never a way to create. Focus stays in the field so the next keystroke corrects the query.

Worth deciding: the field's own ⊗ already clears. The separate Clear button is here because the spec asks for one, but this is the one place the platform already does the job.
Gather's existing Unavailable state, reused word for word from the connection gate, with Retry.
Dark is not a second design: it is the phone's own tokens, and each Module tint already has a dark pair.

Open question for you.

The spec says a tasting row's context is its Kind — but the badge already says "Cheese", so it would repeat itself. Drawn here as title + badge, no context line.

Say the word if you'd rather the badge read "Tasting" and the Kind move into the context line.

No thumbnails, even for Recipes.

One type in five has a picture; giving it a 56px thumb makes an even rhythm impossible for the other four. The tint carries type recognition instead.
